state_analysis: The analysis_report.txt file was created successfully. Now I need to create the optimized_logrotate.conf and rotation_summary.csv files.
explanation: Creating the optimized logrotate configuration file and the CSV summary file.

commands.keystrokes:
cat > /app/optimized_logrotate.conf << 'EOF'
# Optimized Logrotate Configuration
# Generated by Log Rotation Analyzer

/var/log/samples/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root root
    dateext
    maxsize 50M
}

/var/log/samples/system.log {
    daily
    rotate 90
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 root adm
    dateext
    maxsize 100M
}

/var/log/samples/access.log {
    daily
    rotate 14
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    maxsize 100M
    sharedscripts
    postrotate
        [ -f /var/run/nginx.pid ] && kill -USR1 $(cat /var/run/nginx.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
    endscript
}

/var/log/samples/error.log {
    daily
    rotate 60
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    maxsize 50M
}

/var/log/samples/debug.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 644 www-data www-data
    dateext
    maxsize 20M
}
EOF
